    Class
    Description
    DocumentSourceException
    The document source (OneDrive) could not be reached or refused the request.
    DomainException
    Base type for rule violations and port failures raised by the domain.
    InvalidMoveException
    The requested move is not allowed, for example moving a session to the location it is already in.
    SandboxFailureException
    A sandbox port (agent or transfer) could not complete its work.
    SessionBusyException
    The session is running a turn or moving, so it cannot accept the requested operation right now.

    An aggregate was changed by someone else between loading it and saving it.
